cases.prompt: В C++17 есть код: `std::vector<int> values; values.reserve(1); values.push_back(1); int* first = &values[0]; values.push_back(2);`. После этого `first` передают в другой слой. Что проверить и что можно утверждать?
assertions: identifies possible invalidation after reallocation
requires checking uses outside the mutating function
does not call one successful run proof of pointer validity

cases.prompt: В C++ коде `Node* node = new Node; table.emplace(key, node);` вызывается до `delete node`; `table` хранит обычные указатели, а `emplace` может выбросить исключение. Проведи review владения.
assertions: tracks ownership on success and exception paths
identifies the raw-pointer lifetime risk without assuming the exact container outcome
proposes an ownership representation or explicit cleanup boundary

cases.prompt: Функция делает `std::string payload = std::move(request.body);` и затем считает `request.body.empty()` доказательством, что тело уже обработано. Верно ли это?
assertions: does not assume a moved-from string is necessarily empty
distinguishes object validity from a promised value
asks for or proposes an explicit processed-state invariant

cases.prompt: Один C++ билд считает plain `char` signed, другой unsigned; код ветвится по `std::numeric_limits<char>::is_signed`. Как точно описать это различие и что не следует называть UB?
assertions: classifies the signedness choice as implementation-defined rather than automatically undefined behaviour
preserves formal identifiers
uses Russian terminology for the behaviour class

cases.prompt: C++ тест падает с `-O2`, но проходит с `-O0`. Команда предлагает оставить `-O0` в production как fix. Как ответить?
assertions: treats the optimisation difference as diagnostic evidence
does not present disabling optimisation as a repair
asks for a minimal reproducer and an invariant or rule to verify

cases.prompt: Один поток вызывает `jobs.push_back(job)`, другой одновременно проверяет `jobs.empty()`; `jobs` — обычный `std::vector<Job>`, синхронизации нет. Некоторые считают чтение harmless. Что установить до исправления?
assertions: identifies that reads as well as writes matter for shared non-atomic state
does not call the read harmless
asks to establish the intended synchronization or concurrency contract

cases.prompt: Потребитель должен ждать задачу. В C++17 он вызывает `cv.wait(lock);`, затем без проверки читает `queue.front()`. Какие условия и проверку нужно добавить?
assertions: requires a predicate or loop that rechecks the queue condition
ties waiting behaviour to the stated consumer requirement
does not invent delivery guarantees unrelated to waiting

cases.prompt: После исправления C++ кода ASan не нашёл ошибок в одном тесте. Можно ли написать, что use-after-free устранён во всём модуле?
assertions: treats a clean sanitizer run as evidence for the executed path rather than complete proof
asks for relevant coverage or a reproducer
does not dismiss sanitizers as useless

cases.prompt: После обновления shared library приложение стало падать только у одного клиента. Есть подозрение, что `Config` собран с разными определениями по разные стороны ABI boundary, но точные заголовки и флаги неизвестны. Что можно утверждать и что проверить?
assertions: keeps the ODR or ABI issue conditional until build evidence is available
asks for headers, compilation flags, and boundary details
does not call the suspected mismatch a proven root cause

cases.prompt: В C++17 локальный `bool ready;` читается в `if (ready)` до присваивания. В debug тест обычно проходит. Как сформулировать дефект и минимальную проверку?
assertions: identifies reading an uninitialized state as a defect
does not treat a passing debug test as proof
requires explicit initialization and a focused check

cases.prompt: Базовый C++ класс возвращает callback-слот так: `virtual callback_t& on_event() { static callback_t empty; return empty; }`. Два независимых экземпляра не переопределяют метод. Router назначает callback первому, а перед привязкой второго проверяет `bool(second.on_event())`. Проведи review минимального исправления. Пустой `std::function` означает свободный слот, а provider должен жить дольше Router и pending operations.
assertions: identifies that the function-local static callback object is shared by both instances using the base implementation
chooses per-instance member storage or an explicitly keyed equivalent because the established contract requires isolated slots
preserves an empty std::function as the unclaimed sentinel and does not replace it with a no-op lambda
does not claim that thread-safe static initialization makes later mutable access isolated or synchronized
keeps provider callback-target and pending-operation lifetime as a separate contract after the storage fix

cases.prompt: Design a new C++ library with `core` and `text` domains. There is no existing layout or explicit team preference. Choose the header dependency architecture, propose the initial directory layout, and explain what alternatives remain available.
assertions: selects hierarchical umbrella-based dependencies as the default for a new project without presenting it as a C++ language rule
names self-contained headers / Include What You Use and Hybrid as alternatives and does not repeatedly ask for a choice when no preference was given
proposes domain umbrellas with an optional public root umbrella and avoids artificial directory depth or optional-backend aggregation
distinguishes a header-only `include/<library_name>/...` layout from a compiled `src/<library_name>/...` layout

cases.prompt: A new C++ library has an explicit team requirement: every public header must be self-contained under Include What You Use, and independently consumed widgets must keep their own include entry points. How should the architecture policy respond?
assertions: respects the explicit self-contained-header choice instead of overriding it with the Sovetwave default
requires each independent header to include its own dependencies and be checked as a first include
keeps domain umbrellas as optional aggregation rather than making private leaf context a requirement for independent widgets
requires supported exceptions and public include paths to be documented in architecture material and Doxygen

cases.prompt: `<library/core.hpp>` aggregates `<library/text.hpp>`, while `<library/text.hpp>` includes `<library/core.hpp>` because `text` is stored under the core directory. Review this design and state the smallest correction.
assertions: separates directory nesting from dependency direction and identifies the umbrella cycle
keeps a parent umbrella as the aggregator while a standalone subdomain entry point includes only lower-level contracts it needs
proposes extracting a smaller shared contract or revising the domain boundary when the subdomain needs a parent declaration
does not treat `#pragma once` or another include guard as a fix for a cyclic dependency

cases.prompt: `src/library/core/Parser.hpp` is a private leaf that intentionally relies on declarations supplied by `<library/core.hpp>`. `Parser.cpp` currently includes `Parser.hpp` first and fails because the domain context is missing. What include order and compilation checks are justified?
assertions: classifies `Parser.hpp` as a private leaf rather than promising standalone compilation
requires `Parser.cpp` to establish the domain umbrella context before the private leaf when that context is part of the contract
allows own-header-first inclusion when a header is genuinely self-contained and does not turn the usual idiom into an unconditional rule
separately checks the public domain umbrella and any declared independent headers while avoiding an artificial standalone test for the private leaf

cases.prompt: A private `ui` leaf includes `../../storage/types.hpp`, and a separate widget is intended for independent consumers. The project has configured `include/` as an include root. Review the include paths and boundaries.
assertions: rejects `../` traversal and backslash separators in project include paths
uses local quoted paths only within the current domain and include-root-qualified paths or a public storage contract across domains
does not let a private leaf bypass its own domain umbrella to reach a neighbouring private leaf
allows the independent widget to expose a documented standalone entry point when independent use is an established requirement

cases.prompt: An existing C++ library has public headers under `include/library/`, implementations under `src/`, a working installed consumer, and no reported include or build defect. A proposal asks to move every `.hpp` beside its `.cpp` merely to match a new-project preference. Review the proposal.
assertions: preserves the established brownfield layout when its public and installed-consumer contracts are working
does not impose the new-project `src/<library_name>/...` preference as a migration requirement without a concrete compatibility or build need
identifies the installed consumer and public include contract as relevant evidence
names a concrete requirement or observed defect that would justify a layout change

cases.prompt: A new CMake project contains a header-only utility and a small compiled library. There is no runtime plugin or separately deployed ABI. Choose target kinds and explain what evidence would justify a different choice.
assertions: chooses INTERFACE for the header-only utility and STATIC as the uncomplicated default for the small compiled library
does not choose SHARED merely because CMake supports it
names runtime loading, DLL distribution, or a separately deployed ABI as reasons to consider SHARED
ties the target choice to the consumer and compatibility contract rather than personal preference

cases.prompt: A library must be loaded as a DLL plugin by an independently deployed host. Review a proposal that keeps it STATIC and ignores ABI, ownership, and installation contracts.
assertions: selects SHARED or the platform-equivalent dynamic target because runtime loading is an established requirement
requires an explicit ABI, ownership, versioning, and installation contract before treating the choice as complete
does not claim that SHARED is a universal default for every compiled library
verifies an installed consumer or plugin-loading boundary rather than only the source-tree build

relation.expect: STATIC is the simple default for a small library without dynamic deployment, while a real plugin boundary justifies SHARED plus its compatibility contract

cases.prompt: Several application domains exchange the same DTOs, enumerations, and conversion functions. A proposal keeps duplicating them in each domain. Review the domain boundary.
assertions: allows a purposeful data domain for genuinely shared DTOs, enumerations, constants, or conversions
uses one owned boundary rather than duplicating the shared types across domains
keeps the data domain narrow and aligned with dependency direction
does not treat the existence of structs alone as sufficient evidence for a data domain

cases.prompt: A `Waveform` structure and its conversion helpers are used only by the `audio` domain. An agent proposes moving them into a generic `data` folder because they are structs. Evaluate the proposal.
assertions: keeps the audio-owned type and helpers in the audio domain when no cross-domain contract exists
rejects creating a data bucket solely because the entities are structs or conversions
would introduce a data domain only after a real shared consumer and boundary are established
preserves ownership and dependency direction over classification by type shape

relation.expect: a narrow data domain is justified by genuinely shared contracts, while domain-exclusive types stay with their owning domain
